title: catabrosa pauciflora
intro: Catabrosa pauciflora, commonly known as Fescue Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and soothing respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Catabrosa pauciflora are attributed to its ability to modulate immune response, exhibit antioxidant properties, and have antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
